svg.text: Registration happens once per device; the out-of-box flow runs every time the device is deployed or reset. Nothing is imaged.

svg.text: Pre-provisioning and self-deploying need TPM 2.0 with attestation on a physical device. Entra join is the standard; hybrid join is a documented exception.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Numbers mark the order of events; letters mark alternatives.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
